description: A photograph showing an exploited peat bog landscape, characterised by dark brown, exposed soil. The area features prominent linear trenches, some of which contain standing water, forming distinct parcels of land. Sparse vegetation is visible within some trenches, and a distant line of green trees or shrubs marks the horizon under a bright, overcast sky. The image is copyrighted "©European Union, 2012" and attributed to "LUCAS". This landscape represents an open exploited peat producing wetland, consistent with peat extraction in mires.
